eligibility: Start only after repair19 QUEUE.json is COMPLETE and etapa3_postclose_20260923_20/POSTCLOSE_VERIFIED_01.json independently recalculates scoped functional Stage3 successfully and links by SHA256 to the current repair19 queue and final raw receipt. Otherwise remain DORMANT; preserve the historical hidden-state FAIL and both unsuccessful prior attempts.
limitation_observed: Binary half-plane odor yielded bilateral turns but gives no evidence that new spatial samples affect the command or help locate a finite source.
operation: Replace only the binary trial boundary after the same 40 ms sham preparation with two fixed Gaussian sources derived once from the frozen prepared antennal pose; leave CNS, PN629-off intervention, decoder, body, clocks and parameters unchanged.
legal_information: Geometry of the common prepared body, the unchanged AntennalBoundary Gaussian, prior source manifests and online pose/sensor input. No target heading, source label, route or success signal enters the organism.

rivals.A: A change of spatial intensity/history from S+ versus S- is consumed and creates a reproducible difference in neural command within 400 ms.
rivals.B: The two fields are consumed and measurably different, but the present circuit/decoder gives no material command difference in that horizon.
rivals.C: A boundary/clock/consumer mismatch or inadequate field separation prevents interpreting the pair; this is a measurement/interface issue before biology.

difference_from_parent: Stage3 uses a binary half-plane; this gate uses a smooth finite planar source pair with equal initial left/right concentrations across sources and subsequent intensity variation. It is an input/observation experiment, not a new neural law or motor architecture.
controls: Same prepared checkpoint, pose, PN629-off operator, angular reader, forward command, source sigma, observer and horizon; paired native and reference profiles. Existing binary/sham traces are contextual, not new confirmation arms.

fixed_inputs.guard_scope: Only hash-checked geometry, prepared root pose and antenna geoms; exact common neural preparation still requires identical checkpoint/source/state checks. A v2 helper will use the tolerance below after checking already exposed Stage3 reference preparations.
fixed_inputs.source_determination: Fixed in GEOMETRY.json and CAMPOS.json before any new organism result; never recenter at trial pose or tune on outcome.

preflight.guard_tolerance_basis: Previously exposed Stage3 reference preparations differ from the native GEOMETRY by 4.514721929638199e-12 root-native and 1.291450280049844e-11 mm antenna at 40 ms. This prospective identity guard is above those differences but far below the 0.23 mm baseline; it is not a relaxation of any neural/behavioral error criterion.
preflight.initial_concentration_basis: At the already observed Stage3 reference preparation, the fixed native-centered S+/S- sources differ by 1.0376144388146713e-12 in initial concentration solely from the 1e-11 mm pose discrepancy; native difference is 1.11e-16. The 1e-11 guard is prospective for this new pilot, not an outcome tolerance.

observation.ORN_scope: Observer captures actual adapter drive arguments and device boundary buffers at the declared calls, with complete-buffer hashes and bilateral ORN_DM1 indices. It does not inspect every CUDA kernel read.
observation.PN_scope: NativeFlowTap records the signed orn_pn_synaptic kernel net and target for DM1_lPN 10176/10208 and checks the coefficient returned for integration. It does not observe the later 629 general outputs (disabled) or 466 electrical/Ca outputs, and does not isolate the ORN contribution to the signed net.
observation.PN_general_buffer_scope: Adapter PN boundary is hashed; because the PN629 general route is disabled, buffer presence alone is not proof of consumption. A false general_transmission capture binding is expected and is not a biological failure.

sequential_decision: Run native plus and minus from separately loaded identical preparations; stop if a source, clock, consumer or budget guard fails.

If both complete, check source separation and command contrast from raw traces without changing sources. If no resolvable input difference, classify C. If input differs but command does not, classify B at this horizon.
Only if output contrast is material, run reference plus and minus, then recalculate source/consumer and command agreement. A remains a functional intensity/history result, never Stage4 navigation.
stop: Stop on first failed guard or budget; preserve prefixes. No gain, field, source, horizon, solver or threshold retuning after observing new organism data.
qualification: At most a locally confirmed intensity/history-to-command effect in a synthetic roller body, pending independent review. Full Stage4 source navigation requires a later fixed online-versus-yoked perturbation from matched state, source-distance and correction outcomes, plus controls; this gate cannot qualify it.
